items.title: Etzioni on AI: Startup speed is not a strategy
items.summary: AI startups should run experiments fast but make big commitments slowly, Oren Etzioni argues, because speed alone can't build a defensible business when every competitor can build quickly too. He goes through the five usual arguments for speed, says only one holds up and makes the case for proprietary data and relationships as a startup's real advantage. Read More
